scientific_question: Can the measured radial-heavy carry source clear the compact temporal-direction gate when the same eight-bit code reallocates one bit from angle to conditional radius?

causal_basis.observation: At real trajectory step 8, radial quantization contributes 0.037332 distortion and 92.45% of total codec error, while angular quantization contributes only 0.003050. All 256 codes are active and mean joint entropy is 7.808 bits.
causal_basis.mechanism: Use 16 fixed angular sectors and 16 Lloyd-fitted radii per sector. The packed code remains radius_index*16+angle_index, exactly one uint8 per pair. Tail-aware geometric initialization spans 0.2*RMS through the observed per-sector maximum so three Lloyd passes can fit the measured heavy tail without violating the optimizer-time gate.
causal_basis.rate_distortion_projection: Holding measured angular error fixed and quartering eight-bin radial error predicts total distortion approximately 0.012383 before accounting for the coarser angular grid. This is below the frozen 0.02 target and is the only measurement-authorized bit reallocation.
excluded_moves: dense ambient carry or master weight
change the base pair-VQ weight chart
change attention, optimizer, learning rate, seeds, or data order
8-angle x 32-radius allocation because projected angular distortion alone is too large
